name: Algebraic Constraint Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit "sum exactly matches 3" constraint with a requirement that a 2x2 matrix parameterized by the two node values must be non-singular. This requires the model to symbolically evaluate the determinant (p_u^2 - p_v^2 != 0) and deduce that it implies p_u != p_v over the domain {1, 2}, bridging linear algebra and graph theory before it can recognize the underlying 2-coloring structure.
